messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-runtime kvcache memory spike detected on shard-host-27. Multiple OOMs and downstream 5xx errors. Root thread ts: 3067890123
Anya (oncall): I'm paged and looking. Grafana alerts show kvcache OOMs starting ~3067890100. Any recent runtime or batching changes? :eyes:
Matt (eng-runtime): No full runtime deploys in last 2h. We did adjust autoscaler/batch-config earlier today for a few tenants (low-risk tweak).
Kevin (sre): Paging metrics: kvcache.used_bytes jumped from ~12GB -> ~78GB in ~7m. Eviction loop couldn't keep up; several processes crashed with OOM. Logs show many large prefix reads from a tiny set of sessions.
Lisa (support): We're seeing customer reports: multiple PROD customers hit 502/timeout spikes around 12:04 UTC. Need an interim status update for status.redwood.ai if this impacts SLAs.
Anya (oncall): Triage checklist: 1) immediate prefetch throttle on hosted runtime 2) reduce continuous_batching max_window 3) enable aggressive eviction override 4) prepare rollback for batch-config tweak. Who can push 1+2 quickly?
Matt (eng-runtime): I can push lightweight config changes. Proposed hotfix (minimal):
```
# runtime/hosted/batching.yaml (hotfix)
continuous_batching:
  max_window: 256    # was 1024
  max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_prefetch_limit: 4  # was 32
```
I'll canary to a subset then roll to prod if green.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: start rollout roll-3067890157 -> 10% on hosted-prod-us-east
Matt (eng-runtime): Canary looks stable after 2m. Memory used down ~18% on canary hosts. Rolling to 100%.
deploy-bot: rollout roll-3067890157 -> 100% complete
Kevin (sre): Executed eviction override on shard-host-27 and peers. Run:
```
sudo curl -X POST http://kvcache-admin.local/host/27/evict -d '{"target_bytes":60000000000,"strategy":"aggressive-lru"}'
```
Freed ~40GB across hosts; OOMs stopped within ~90s. We're seeing backpressure on request paths but 5xxs dropping.
Lisa (support): Errors are dropping; one large customer still seeing slow tail latency. Drafting status: "Applied mitigation to reduce prefetching and batching windows; memory pressure reduced, investigating root cause." Shall we post?
Anya (oncall): Post an initial update and tag affected customers. Note we're investigating if long prompts caused runaway context growth. @Matt capture heap/dump and kvmap snapshot for triage.
Matt (eng-runtime): Captures uploaded: s3://redwood-dumps/3067890123/kvcache-host-27-heap.tgz
Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted/kvcache?orgId=1&from=3067890000&to=3067890300
Kevin (sre): Quick triage: many requests had token spans >12k; a client-side loop was generating incremental prefixes and continuous batching held KV windows open until full response. Prefetch multiplier (32) amplified a small set of sessions into many pinned entries -> shard blowup.
Anya (oncall): Hypothesis: regression in the interplay of continuous batching + prefetch. Long session prompts + high prefetch multiplier resulted in runaway KV growth.
Matt (eng-runtime): Next dev follow-ups: 1) cap per-session kvcache entries (soft cap) 2) add prefetch backpressure when session_kv_bytes > threshold 3) automated tests for longprompt + batching interactions 4) audit recent batch-config tweak.
Kevin (sre): Immediate safety change: applied soft caps on hosted runtime defaults: per-session cap=20MB, shard_global_cap=60GB. If session hits cap, prefetch for that session is stopped and we log event.
config-bot: config-bot: updated kvcache-defaults: session_kv_cap=20MB, shard_global_cap=60GB
Anya (oncall): Good. Handoff: Matt, you'll own post-incident triage and RCA for 2h. I'll draft postmortem skeleton and customer comms.
Matt (eng-runtime): Taking handoff. Initial timeline + reproducer work in progress. Early note: small number of tenants with sustained longprompt patterns likely triggered this; reproducer aims to emulate incremental prefixing + high prefetch multiplier.
Lisa (support): I'll prepare a customer-facing note once RCA draft is ready. Include mitigations and ETA for permanent fix.
Anya (oncall): Closing pager loop for now: mitigations applied, OOMs mitigated, customer impact limited to transient errors. Assigning high priority RCA: owners = eng-runtime (Matt), SRE (Kevin). Postmortem deadline: 72h.
Matt (eng-runtime): Will follow up with timeline, diff of config changes, and a small reproducer script. Sample repro note to include in postmortem: steps to run a client loop that sends long prompts with incremental context and monitors kvcache growth.
Kevin (sre): Also adding an alert change: fire earlier if kvcache growth rate > 10GB/min for >2min and per-shard kvmap cardinality spike > X.
Anya (oncall): Thanks team. If anyone finds other affected hosts, ping this thread. I'll update the incident ticket with timeline and mitigation log. :white_check_mark:
